changes: Stopped syncing Rewind OCR history and embeddings to shared cloud storage
Simplified Chat and background agents to one managed Pi runtime and moved Ask Mode into Advanced AI Setup
Clarified how managed cloud transcription usage is described in Settings
Stopped the Mac app from provisioning a cloud agent VM or mirroring its local database there
Removed Apps, external connectors, public sharing, Brain Map, and broad file indexing to focus Omi on one personal assistant
Removed customer API-key controls and routed desktop AI, voice, transcription, and agent requests through managed Omi access
Removed legacy push-to-talk analytics, Crisp support, and in-app message ratings while preserving diagnostics and issue reporting
Removed browser automation and website-control tools from the desktop assistant
Replaced legacy billing screens with server-managed plans and a safe Skip action when purchasing is unavailable
Made the Mac conversation archive fully local, including search, folders, speaker names, merge, deletion, and restart recovery
Kept Rewind history and search private to this Mac by removing the retired cloud copy
Simplified desktop setup to the retained identity, permission, shortcut, and listening choices with safer reset and sign-out cleanup
Made Home the single Chat workspace with conversations and attachments stored locally on your Mac
Made Focus, Insights, AI Profile, and assistant notification preferences local to this Mac and available without cloud synchronization
Made managed transcription save directly to the Mac's local conversation archive without cloud conversation state
Made Memories fully local, restart-safe, and available offline on Mac
Tasks and Goals now stay local to this Mac and continue working without cloud synchronization
Made fair-use reviews use bounded local conversation evidence and added a truthful on-device fallback when managed transcription pauses
Improved push-to-talk reliability and made conversation, memory, recap, and task answers use your local Mac data
Stopped delayed Memory, Task, Focus, reminder, and embedding work from crossing account changes
Simplified desktop navigation and Settings around Home, Memory, Tasks, and Insights
Added Export My Data for a complete owner-scoped JSON copy of conversations, Memories, tasks, goals, Chat, Focus, and approved settings stored on this Mac
Made Omi's retained AI features use fixed managed models and removed general public-web search
Removed remaining hosted search and cloud attachment staging so Mac search and files stay local
Simplified the cloud backend while keeping listening, voice messages, and account deletion available
Fixed desktop account, task, conversation, memory, and voice flows that could show stale state or fail to complete
Stopped the Mac app from importing legacy Omi data or removing Omi app bundles during startup
Prevented downloaded updates from interrupting active recording, voice, tool, or Chat work
Simplified managed Chat and realtime voice to use Gemini while preserving spoken-answer fallback
Improved managed Chat diagnostics while keeping conversations and tool execution on this Mac
Aligned the macOS experience with Intentive identity, local-data truth, managed-provider disclosure, and optional product analytics controls
Refreshed Intentive's app icon, sign-in backdrop, permission guidance, and installer presentation
Removed retired product names from the built-in screen-analysis exclusion lists
Improved sign-in privacy by omitting account IDs, email addresses, and OAuth callback details from local diagnostic logs
Fixed a race that could send push-to-talk input before updated chat history was ready
Made named local development launches stay on their workspace services and stop without affecting other Intentive apps
Development builds can use explicitly selected real voice AI while keeping test accounts and data local.
